output.subject: Quick chat about our whole milk pricing
output.body:
Hi Lee Valley Wholesale team,

Thank you for looking after The Corner Café so well. We really value working with you, and I'd like to keep it that way.

I'm writing because I've found a lower price on one of our key products. We currently pay €4.20 for your 2L whole milk, and I've seen it offered elsewhere at €2.69. We go through a lot of it every week, so the difference matters to us.

Could you match that price of €2.69? If you can, we'll happily keep our regular orders with you.

Could you please reply by {reply_by_date}? I'm glad to talk it through by phone if that's easier.

Thanks so much,

Aoife
The Corner Café
